# VisionzLab

> AI consulting brand by Frank Goortani — AI-driven architecture, automation, and cloud-native solutions for organizations integrating AI into production.

VisionzLab is Frank Goortani's AI architecture studio for adopting and operationalizing AI/LLM systems: production RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, infrastructure design, and team enablement. Frank Goortani has been full-time CTO at FasterOutcomes since June 2025, focused on production LLM systems for legal and healthcare workflows, AI governance, and engineering leadership. Previously Solution Architect at Uber (2021–2025) and Software Consultant at The Home Depot Canada.
